one_liner: Grain records, transcribes, and organizes meetings so teams can review conversations, share insights, and manage meeting content.

auth.notes: Personal Access Tokens and Workspace Access Tokens sent as Bearer tokens; OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE support for integrations

evidence.snippet: Every request needs a token in the Authorization header and a Public-Api-Version header
There are three types of tokens which can have one of two access scopes.
OAuth2 Flow This authentication method is for developers building integrations with Grain to be used by any Grain users.

access.notes: Any developer can generate Personal Access Tokens directly from account settings without approval or payment

evidence.snippet: Create a Personal Access Token A Personal Access Token (PAT) authenticates requests as you, with the same access you have in Grain.
Grain is free to use, simple to set up, and affordable for your entire company.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Token bucket per auth token: 30 request burst capacity, 2 req/sec refill rate, 120 req/min sustained

evidence.snippet: The Grain API lets you read and manage recordings, highlights, uploads, and more.
Grain rate limits requests with a token bucket algorithm per auth token.
Create a Grain webhook subscription after Grain verifies that the public HTTPS callback returns a 2xx response.
The Grain MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects Claude.ai (and other AI chat clients) directly to your meeting data in Grain,

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials available immediately without approval, documented REST API with webhooks and rate limits, official MCP server published, Composio toolkit already exists with 17 tools.
